div.p: DeviceDefinition represents reusable definitions for kinds of devices and device components. It uses DeviceDefinition.hasPart to describe the component definitions that are direct parts of the current definition. A component definition can be reused by more than one parent definition, and DeviceDefinition.hasPart.count can state how many instances of that component are expected in a device built from the definition.

Device represents a particular device instance. A specific component device can be part of only one encompassing device at a given time, so the instance relationship is represented in the opposite direction with Device.parent. For example, a vital signs monitor DeviceDefinition can list blood pressure, oximeter, and temperature module definitions as parts, while the corresponding module Device instances reference the monitor Device as their parent when installed.
